dialogue_segments.text: Or has your sudden climb to power sweetened your taste already?

dialogue_segments.text: Only if it sweetens your disposition, Catherine.

dialogue_segments.text: The estate is practically ours.

dialogue_segments.text: The succession papers are being finalized as we speak.

dialogue_segments.text: Lady Juliana! Please! You have to help me, Toby is dying!

dialogue_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Anguished, Resentful)
dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: He shut the door in my face because we have no silver!

dialogue_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Bitter, Tearful)
dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: The manor doctor laughed! He said village boys are not worth his time!

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Sorrowful, Dejected)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: We have no clinic now.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Despondent)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Our cottage is ashes. I have nothing left but this coltsfoot.

dialogue_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Pleading, Desperate)
dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: He is only seven! If you do not come, he will die! You are his only hope, Lady Juliana!

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Resolute, Authoritative)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Stand up. Sinking to your knees will not save him. Let me grab my ledger. We go now.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Alarmed, Focused)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: His skin is burning hot.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Commanding)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Prudence, fetch hot water immediately!

dialogue_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Hurried, Obedient)
dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: Yes! Right away, I will get it!

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (V.O.) (Introspective, Determined)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I cannot let my own weariness stop me. This boy needs my mother's knowledge.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Instructive, Calm)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Lift his shoulders, Prudence. Hold the steam close. Let him inhale.

dialogue_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Tearful, Coaxing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: Like this? Toby, breathe it in, sweet boy.

action_segments.text: Lady Juliana immediately reaches down and pulls Prudence firmly back to her feet, then turns to snatch her heavy leather-bound herbal ledger from the wooden workbench.

dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Prudence, fetch hot water immediately!

dialogue_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Hurried, Obedient)
dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: Yes! Right away, I will get it!

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (V.O.) (Introspective, Determined)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I cannot let my own weariness stop me. This boy needs my mother's knowledge.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Instructive, Calm)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Lift his shoulders, Prudence. Hold the steam close. Let him inhale.

dialogue_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Tearful, Coaxing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: Like this? Toby, breathe it in, sweet boy.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Encouraging, Reassuring)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Yes, just like that. Keep breathing, Toby. Let the vapor clear your chest.

dialogue_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Overwhelmed, Relieved)
dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: Oh, thank God! His chest is quiet! The rattling has stopped!

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Gentle, Caring)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Keep him warm. Give him three drops of this coltsfoot tea every morning.

dialogue_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Grateful, Choked with Emotion)
dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: You saved him. The grand doctors left him to choke, but you...

dialogue_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Fervent, Devoted)
dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: I have no money, Lady Juliana, but I swear on my life, I will do anything to repay you.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Warm, Sincere)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Your brother's breath is payment enough for me, Prudence.

dialogue_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Indignant, Resentful)
dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: At the grand manor, they ignore us. They only care about their own luxury.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Lady Juliana rushes in, sets the ledger on the rustic wooden table, and quickly flips open the pages.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Lady Juliana places her bandaged hand against Toby's flushed, sweating forehead as he wheezes painfully.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Prudence wraps a cloth around the iron handle of the steaming kettle resting over the hearth fire and lifts it.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Lady Juliana crushes dried herbal leaves into a dark wooden bowl between her bandaged hands, then pours steaming water over them from the kettle.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Lady Juliana sits beside the pallet and brings the steaming herbal bowl close to Toby's face while Prudence cradles his shoulders.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Toby's strained wheezing eases into quiet, rhythmic breathing as he slips into peaceful sleep on his pillow.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Lady Juliana pulls the plaid wool blanket snug over Toby's chest, smiling softly with profound relief.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Lady Juliana takes Prudence's trembling hands into hers, smiling with heartfelt warmth.

logline: When an arrogant noblewoman catches Juliana in the poisoned Dowager Duchess's chambers, she strikes Juliana with a riding crop and sentences her to scrub the hearth, unaware that Juliana has secretly hidden the antidote and remedy journal to finish the Duchess's cure.
continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 23's cliffhanger inside the West Wing bedchamber, as the brass latch turns and the door swings open to reveal an unexpected intruder confronting Lady Juliana and Prudence.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Humble, Measured)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Juliana, my lady. I was hired for the winter cleaning.

dialogue_segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Accusatory, Strict)
dialogue_segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
dialogue_segments.text: And who gave you permission to enter this chamber?

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Softly Defiant)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I heard her. I thought Her Grace needed help.

dialogue_segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Scoffing, Cruel)
dialogue_segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
dialogue_segments.text: You thought? A new maid thinks she knows better than the physicians?

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Emphatic, Defiant)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: She is suffering.

dialogue_segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Vicious, Venomous)
dialogue_segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Then let her suffer.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Steely, Steadfast)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I cannot do that.

dialogue_segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Cold, Threatening)
dialogue_segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
dialogue_segments.text: You are a maid.

dialogue_segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Cold, Continuing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Not a physician. Not a lady.

dialogue_segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Disdainful, Final)
dialogue_segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
dialogue_segments.text: And certainly not a woman whose opinion matters.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Subdued, Controlled)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Yes, my lady.

dialogue_segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Smug, Condescending)
dialogue_segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Good. Perhaps we can teach you your place.

dialogue_segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Harsh, Dismissive)
dialogue_segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Clean it.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Quiet, Questioning)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: All of it, my lady?

dialogue_segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Intimate, Venomous)
dialogue_segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Every stone. Perhaps when your hands are black enough, you will finally remember what you are.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Behind her grey skirt, Juliana quickly slips the small glass remedy vial into her apron pocket with her charcoal-dusted fingers.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: The noblewoman suddenly rears back her riding crop and strikes Juliana violently across the torso.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Juliana gasps in pain, clutching her stomach and bending over as she absorbs the brutal strike.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: The noblewoman leads Juliana and a frightened Prudence down a dark flagstone hallway.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: Juliana's boots step down into a dark, rustic chamber dominated by an enormous, blackened stone hearth.

dialogue_segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Accusatory, Strict)
dialogue_segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
dialogue_segments.text: And who gave you permission to enter this chamber?

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Softly Defiant)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I heard her. I thought Her Grace needed help.

dialogue_segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Scoffing, Cruel)
dialogue_segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
dialogue_segments.text: You thought? A new maid thinks she knows better than the physicians?

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Emphatic, Defiant)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: She is suffering.

dialogue_segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Vicious, Venomous)
dialogue_segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Then let her suffer.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Steely, Steadfast)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I cannot do that.

dialogue_segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Cold, Threatening)
dialogue_segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
dialogue_segments.text: You are a maid.

dialogue_segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Cold, Continuing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Not a physician. Not a lady.

dialogue_segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Disdainful, Final)
dialogue_segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
dialogue_segments.text: And certainly not a woman whose opinion matters.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Subdued, Controlled)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Yes, my lady.

dialogue_segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Smug, Condescending)
dialogue_segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Good. Perhaps we can teach you your place.

dialogue_segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Harsh, Dismissive)
dialogue_segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Clean it.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Quiet, Questioning)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: All of it, my lady?

dialogue_segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Intimate, Venomous)
dialogue_segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Every stone. Perhaps when your hands are black enough, you will finally remember what you are.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Whispering, Sinister)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Because this is what you were always meant to be.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Scornful)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Your family dressed you like a lady. They educated you. They gave you a respectable name.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Amused, Spiteful)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: [chuckles] And still you became a disgrace.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Fierce, Unbroken)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I became a disgrace when I refused to become cruel.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Cold, Bitter)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: No. You became a disgrace when Gerald left you standing at the altar.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Gloating)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Do you remember?

dialogue_segments.text: A scarred nobody.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Resolute, Dignified)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: A man with more honor than the people sitting above this dungeon.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Incredulous, Mocking)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: You call that marriage?

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Pure, Sincere)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I call it love.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Mocking, Hysterical Laugh)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: [laughs] Love? Look where your precious love brought you.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Firm, Piercing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: To a place where I can still look you in the eyes.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Incredulous, Offended)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: You think love makes you better than me?

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Calm, Cutting)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: No. But cruelty certainly doesn't make you better than me.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Incensed, Boastful)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: I have beauty, money, family, status! What do you have?

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Quiet, Powerful)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Knowledge. Love. And people who need me.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Sneering, Derisive)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: [scoffs] Peasants? People?

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Arrogant, Elitist)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: That is why you were born in the wrong world. Women like me are meant to be admired. Women like you are meant to serve.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Piercing, Provocative)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Then why are you so desperate to make me kneel?

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Dignified, Principled)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA

dialogue_segments.text: If you seek shelter in this house, Catherine, you earn it.

dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Second, I want to know what the council knows before it decides anything. Every argument, every witness, every whisper against her.

dialogue_segments.text: You want eyes inside the council chamber itself?

dialogue_segments.text: I want eyes and ears everywhere that decides my future.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Bitterly Resolute)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Is that so unreasonable coming from a woman the church itself just humiliated back into relevance?

dialogue_segments.label: FATHER THOMAS (Wary, Grave)
dialogue_segments.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
dialogue_segments.text: If I keep the hearing open, if I feed you every word spoken behind those doors, what happens to me when the Duke finds out a crowned priest conspired against him?

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Seductive, Reassuring)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Then make certain he doesn't find out. You're careful. I've seen how careful.

dialogue_segments.text: Careful men still hang, my lady, when the crime is treason against a Duke the King himself just restored.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Startled, Indignant)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Gerald? What are you doing here?

dialogue_segments.label: GERALD (Arrogant, Smooth)
dialogue_segments.speaker: GERALD
dialogue_segments.text: I came for something that belongs to me.

dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: You have already taken enough from me. Leave!

dialogue_segments.text: Your husband stole my gold pocket watch!

dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: What? When?

dialogue_segments.label: GERALD (Cold, Certain)
dialogue_segments.speaker: GERALD
dialogue_segments.text: The last time I came here.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Contemptuous, Outraged)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: You never even entered the cottage!

dialogue_segments.label: GERALD (Smug, Threatening)
dialogue_segments.speaker: GERALD
dialogue_segments.text: Then you should have nothing to fear from a search.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Adamant, Protective)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Alexander would never steal from you.

dialogue_segments.label: GERALD (Mocking, Spiteful)
dialogue_segments.speaker: GERALD
dialogue_segments.text: Of course you would defend him. You married a beggar!

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Low, Menacing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: Choose your next words carefully.

dialogue_segments.label: GERALD (Shouting, Dramatic)

dialogue_segments.text: A complaint is not proof.

dialogue_segments.label: CONSTABLE (Cold, Procedural)

dialogue_segments.text: Then a search will settle the matter.

dialogue_segments.text: If he has nothing to hide...

dialogue_segments.label: GERALD (O.S.) (Smug)

dialogue_segments.text: ...let the constable search.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Dark, Grated)

dialogue_segments.text: Search it.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Resigned, Calm)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: Let them.

dialogue_segments.label: INFORMANT (Subservient, Urgent)
dialogue_segments.speaker: INFORMANT
dialogue_segments.text: Your Grace.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Authoritative, Direct)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: Tell me what is happening in Ashburg.

dialogue_segments.label: INFORMANT (Grave, Cautious)
dialogue_segments.speaker: INFORMANT
dialogue_segments.text: Lord Sterling's influence has grown since your disappearance. He has men in the county offices, the courts, even among the household staff.

dialogue_segments.label: INFORMANT (O.S.)
dialogue_segments.speaker: INFORMANT
dialogue_segments.text: Rupert has become the face of Ashburg. He sits in your father's room, signs your estate papers, gives orders as though the title already belongs to him.

dialogue_segments.label: INFORMANT (Earnest)
dialogue_segments.speaker: INFORMANT
dialogue_segments.text: And Lady Catherine, she behaves as though she is already the future duchess.

dialogue_segments.label: INFORMANT (Whispering, Alarmed)
dialogue_segments.speaker: INFORMANT
dialogue_segments.text: But they have separated her from the household. She is watched constantly. Every letter she sends is checked. Every visitor is questioned.

dialogue_segments.label: INFORMANT (O.S.)
dialogue_segments.speaker: INFORMANT
dialogue_segments.text: There are almost no loyal servants left around her.

dialogue_segments.label: INFORMANT (Grave)
dialogue_segments.speaker: INFORMANT
dialogue_segments.text: The people who served your family for years have been dismissed, frightened away, or replaced.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Pained Fury)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: My mother is a prisoner in her own house.

dialogue_segments.label: INFORMANT (Quiet, Solemn)
dialogue_segments.speaker: INFORMANT
dialogue_segments.text: And everyone believes you are dead.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Lethal, Calculating)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: Then let them believe it a little longer.

dialogue_segments.label: INFORMANT (Inquiring, Tense)
dialogue_segments.speaker: INFORMANT
dialogue_segments.text: And when we have the proof?

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Vow of Vengeance, Resolute)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: Then Ashburg will remember who it belongs to.

dialogue_segments.text: You saved mine, too.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Whispering, Tearful)

dialogue_segments.text: Thank you.

dialogue_segments.label: ELDER VILLAGER (Nodding, Earnest)

dialogue_segments.label: THE FORMER GROOM (Impatient, Commanding)
dialogue_segments.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
dialogue_segments.text: Go home quietly, Juliana. At least leave this chapel with some dignity.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Bitter, Defiant)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Dignity?

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Clear, Accusing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: You abandoned a woman who trusted you...

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Off-screen) (Sharp, Piercing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: ...because another woman promised you greater beauty and wealth.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Steely, Resolute)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Do not mistake my heartbreak for your victory, Gerald.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Powerful, Unyielding)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: You wanted this entire chapel to believe that I was not worthy of you. But you have shown them something far more valuable.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Decisive, Scathing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: You have shown them exactly what your word is worth.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Resolute, Proud)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I may leave this chapel without a husband...

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Defiant, Triumphant in Spirit)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: ...but I will not leave it believing I was the one who should be ashamed.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Smug, Prim)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Two lumps of sugar, Rupert?

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Taunting, Silkily)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Or has your sudden climb to power sweetened your taste already?

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Flirtatious, Sly)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: Only if it sweetens your disposition, Catherine.

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Boastful, Confident)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: The estate is practically ours.

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Smug)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: The succession papers are being finalized as we speak.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Cold, Haughty)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: 'Practically' is a word for beggars. I do not marry a practical Duke.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Stern, Ambitious)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: I marry the Lord of Ashbury.

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Reassuring, Firm)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: And so you shall.

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Dark, Conspiratorial)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: Once my cousin Alexander's death is formally sealed by the Crown...

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Decisive)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: ...the title is mine.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Wary, Inquiring)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: And what of the Dowager? The old woman still breathes.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Disdainful)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Her shadow still hangs over this house.

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Quiet, Sinister)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: Her health fails more each day. The physicians are baffled.

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Gloating)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: They call it a wasting of the lungs.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Mock-Sympathetic, Cruel)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: How tragic. The slow, quiet decline.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Scheming)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: How much longer can the frail thing survive?

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Cold, Callous)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: Not through the winter. I've ensured her quiet comfort.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Vindictive)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Good. The village is already whispering about her.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Contemptuous)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: The local peasants are like dogs, barking at every carriage that passes.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Disgusted)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: They disgust me.

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Dismissive, Arrogant)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: They are nothing. Dirt beneath our boots.

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Authoritative, Promising)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: They will learn their place when you wear the ducal crown.

dialogue_segments.label: SEAMUS (Gentle, Concerned)
dialogue_segments.speaker: SEAMUS
dialogue_segments.text: Let me take that basket, Lady Juliana.

dialogue_segments.label: SEAMUS (Empathetic)
dialogue_segments.speaker: SEAMUS
dialogue_segments.text: Your palms are still raw from the fire. You shouldn't be working in this freezing draft.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Fierce, Resolute)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: If I stop, Seamus, the lung fever in the valley wins.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Defiant)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I do not yield to a cold draft.

dialogue_segments.label: SEAMUS (Desperate, Grieving)
dialogue_segments.speaker: SEAMUS
dialogue_segments.text: You are a viscount's daughter!

dialogue_segments.label: SEAMUS (Pleading)
dialogue_segments.speaker: SEAMUS
dialogue_segments.text: Sleeping on straw, sorting weeds!

dialogue_segments.label: SEAMUS (Frustrated)
dialogue_segments.speaker: SEAMUS
dialogue_segments.text: Let the village tend to itself for once!

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Passionate, Unflinching)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: The chapel is gone, Seamus. I am the only healer these people have left.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Unyielding)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I keep the basket.

dialogue_segments.label: SEAMUS (Saddened, Heartbroken)
dialogue_segments.speaker: SEAMUS
dialogue_segments.text: They have reduced you to a peasant.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Proud, Indomitable)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: They have reduced me to myself.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Steely)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: And I am not finished.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Cruel, Callous)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Let the peasants rot in their barns.

dialogue_segments.text: You saved him. The grand doctors left him to choke, but you...

dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: I have no money, Lady Juliana, but I swear on my life, I will do anything to repay you.

dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Your brother's breath is payment enough for me, Prudence.

dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: At the grand manor, they ignore us. They only care about their own luxury.

dialogue_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Ominous)
dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: But their gold cannot buy them health.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Startled, Curious)

dialogue_segments.text: What do you mean? Is someone ill? The Dowager Duchess?

dialogue_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Solemn, O.S.)
dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: She is dying, Lady Juliana.

dialogue_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Conspiratorial, Grim)
dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: A strange, mysterious illness is eating her away.

dialogue_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Dark, Chilling)
dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: Inside that massive house with all their wealth, she is fading to nothing, and no one can stop it.

logline: After defying her own despair to cure a fever-stricken village boy with her mother's herbal remedies, Lady Juliana learns that the Dowager Duchess is secretly withering away from a mysterious illness inside Ashbury Manor.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Instructive, Calm)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Lift his shoulders, Prudence. Hold the steam close. Let him inhale.

dialogue_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Tearful, Coaxing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: Like this? Toby, breathe it in, sweet boy.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Encouraging, Reassuring)

dialogue_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Overwhelmed, Relieved)
dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: Oh, thank God! His chest is quiet! The rattling has stopped!

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Gentle, Caring)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Keep him warm. Give him three drops of this coltsfoot tea every morning.

dialogue_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Grateful, Choked with Emotion)
dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: You saved him. The grand doctors left him to choke, but you...

dialogue_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Fervent, Devoted)
dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: I have no money, Lady Juliana, but I swear on my life, I will do anything to repay you.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Warm, Sincere)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Your brother's breath is payment enough for me, Prudence.

dialogue_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Indignant, Resentful)
dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: At the grand manor, they ignore us. They only care about their own luxury.

dialogue_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Ominous)
dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: But their gold cannot buy them health.

dialogue_segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Weak, Raspy)
dialogue_segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
dialogue_segments.text: Who are you? Speak to me. I have not seen your face before.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Urgent, Reassuring)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Please, Your Grace. Drink the last of this antidote. Drink it slowly.

dialogue_segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Faint, Discerning)
dialogue_segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
dialogue_segments.text: You... you are no common servant. You took Catherine's whip for me the other day.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Humble, Sincere)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I did what I had to. It does not change my duty.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Gentle, Calming)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Rest now, Your Grace. You are safe tonight.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Hushed, Tense Whisper)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: If the guards hear us, we are both dead.

dialogue_segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
dialogue_segments.text: Rupert and Catherine want me dead. They are poisoning me in my own bed, aren't they?

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Reassuring, Steadfast)

dialogue_segments.text: Yes. But the charcoal is fighting the poison. You are safe now.

dialogue_segments.text: What are you hiding?

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Firm)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Nothing.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY CATHERINE (Demanding, Harsh)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Show me your hand.

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Cold, Authoritative)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Girl. Show me what you are holding.

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Skeptical)

dialogue_segments.label: LADY CATHERINE (Mocking, Condescending)

dialogue_segments.label: LADY CATHERINE (Incredulous, Accusing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Who permitted you to give medicine to the Duchess?

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Quiet, Resolute)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: No one.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY CATHERINE (Spiteful, Indignant)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Then you administered it without permission.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Passionate, Urgent)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Because she was dying!

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Cold, Interrogating)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: And you decided you knew better than every physician in this house?

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Fierce)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: The physicians were not saving her!

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (O.S.) (Measured, Menacing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: My aunt has been wasting away for months.

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Smooth, Threatening)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: And now we find an unknown maid alone beside her bed...

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (O.S.) (Contemptuous)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: ...holding a substance no one authorized her to give.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Pleading, Agonized)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: It contains years of her work! Her knowledge! Everything she left me!

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Mocking, Condescending)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Your mother's little book of weeds?

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Cruel, Smug)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: You still call this a legacy?

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Defiant, Furious)

dialogue_segments.text: It is medicine!

dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Of course.

dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Roots. Leaves. Powders. Strange mixtures written in a dead woman's hand.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Icy, Threatening)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: The magistrate will call it witchcraft.

dialogue_segments.text: You know that is a lie!

dialogue_segments.text: I know exactly what I need him to believe.

dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: You cannot just destroy it!

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Whispered, Malicious)

dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: You were cast out once.

dialogue_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Give those facts to a magistrate in the right order, and she becomes a poisoner.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Curious, Conniving)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: And if she claims she is a healer?

dialogue_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Sinister)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Then call it witchcraft.

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Stunned)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: Witchcraft is a capital charge.

dialogue_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Unflinching)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Precisely.

dialogue_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Authoritative, Command)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Do not hide the evidence, manufacture it. Drag her before the magistrate tomorrow, frame the trial, buy the jury, and let the State hang her.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Scheming)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Her botanical ledger...

dialogue_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Confirming)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Exactly.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Inquiring)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: And the Dowager?

dialogue_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Dismissive)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: She is weak, confused. No magistrate will trust a dying woman's accusations against a respected household.

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Hesitant)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: And Juliana?

dialogue_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Cold, Resolute)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: She goes before the magistrate tomorrow.

dialogue_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Cold, Accusatory)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: You have a rat in your cellar, Rupert. And the servants are beginning to smell it.

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Defensive, Anxious)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: The Ashcroft girl is locked tight. Nobody knows she is down there.

dialogue_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Stern, Disapproving)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: The kitchen maids are whispering. They see the soup bowls returned unwiped. They see your guards outside the lower grates.

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Muttered, Paranoid)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: She knows the Duchess was poisoned.

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Fearful)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: If she speaks...

dialogue_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Fierce, Venomous)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Then make certain she isn't! A peasant weed, Rupert! You do not store weeds in your cellar, you burn them!

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Faltering, Submissive)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: What are you suggesting?

dialogue_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Calculated, Ominous)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: We stop hiding the prisoner.

dialogue_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Deadpan, Sinister)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: We give them a reason to condemn her.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Inquiring, Sharp)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: You have a solution?

dialogue_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Ruthless)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: We use the law to destroy her.

dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: I have beauty, money, family, status! What do you have?

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Quiet, Powerful)

dialogue_segments.text: Knowledge. Love. And people who need me.

dialogue_segments.text: This pathetic book is the only thing you still have from your mother.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Desperate, Weeping)

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Gloating, Sadistic)

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Screaming, Agonized)

dialogue_segments.text: No!

dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Continuing)

dialogue_segments.text: You want everyone to fear you.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Mocking, Direct)

dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Choking with Rage)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: You insolent—!

top_evidence_segments.text: He wanted a wife whose family could raise his name. He measured a woman's worth by what she could give him.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Grounded, Powerful)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I was freed. And I found a man who never asked me what I was worth.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Disdainful)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Your soldier?

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Tender, Certain)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: My husband.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Bitter)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: He is a nobody.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Warm, Defiant)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Then I love a nobody.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Resonant, Moving)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Because that nobody showed me more love than your entire world ever did.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Indignant, Sharp)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: You know nothing about my world.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Knowing, Sober)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I know exactly what your world values.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Listing, Deliberate)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Beauty. Money.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Firm)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Family. A perfect name.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Continuing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: And a woman who never embarrasses the people standing behind her.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Shouting, Outraged)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: And what is wrong with that?!

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Gentle, Penetrating)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Nothing. Until you have nothing left beneath it.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Unrelenting)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: You have spent your whole life collecting things that make people bow...

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Piercing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: ...but you have never learned how to make anyone love you.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Hysterical, Screaming)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Silence! Silence!

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Shrieking)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Why?!

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Forceful)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Because I am right!

top_evidence_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
top_evidence_segments.text: Most of them were.

top_evidence_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
top_evidence_segments.text: Then how did you survive?

top_evidence_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
top_evidence_segments.text: And you?

top_evidence_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
top_evidence_segments.text: I crawled away from the battlefield, half dead, alone.

logline: Fleeing her captivity through a secret passage, Alexander's elderly mother treks through a bitter blizzard to a secluded cabin, where she tearfully reunites with her presumed-dead son and learns the horrifying conspiracy behind his supposed demise.
continuity_notes: While Juliana faces trial and sentencing in the courtroom, this episode reveals Alexander's mother escaping confinement and tracking down Alexander in his mountain hideout, uncovering the dark treason that orchestrates both their fates.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Solemn)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: Three years ago, I was sent to the Iberian front.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Steady, Focused)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: It was a classified Crown mission. We were investigating a British officer selling military secrets to French spies.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Shocked)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
dialogue_segments.text: A traitor?

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Firm)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: Yes.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Grave)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: We were close to finding him.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Hardened)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: Then came the ambush.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Bitter, Painful)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: My men were slaughtered.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Trembling, Anxious)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
dialogue_segments.text: And you?

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Hollow)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: I was shot. Left for dead.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Pleading, Astonished)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
dialogue_segments.text: How did you escape?

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Somber, Low)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: I crawled away from the battlefield, half dead, alone.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY CLARISSA (Smug Triumph)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
dialogue_segments.text: Juliana's ruin will be a lesson. And we will be there to watch.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Weak, Whispering through Tears)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: They think hunger will make me surrender.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Fierce Resolve)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: They think fear will make me beg.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Straining, Defiant Gasps)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I will not!

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Passionate Defiance)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: They can take my name. They can take my home.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Indomitable Spirit)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: They cannot take who I am!

dialogue_segments.label: NOBLEMAN (Quietly Skeptical)
dialogue_segments.speaker: NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Do you think she'll actually be executed?

dialogue_segments.label: LADY CLARISSA (Dismissive, Certain)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
dialogue_segments.text: After what she has been accused of? Of course.

dialogue_segments.label: NOBLEMAN (Musing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: She was always stubborn.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY CLARISSA (Bitter, Cold)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
dialogue_segments.text: That was her greatest mistake. She could have accepted what happened. She could have disappeared quietly.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY CLARISSA (Venomous Monologue)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
dialogue_segments.text: Instead she married a nobody, played healer to peasants, challenged people above her. And now the whole county will watch her pay for it.

dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Tender, Deep)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Sincere, Loving)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Low, Passionate)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: You chose me when I had nothing.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Resolute, Warm)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I chose you because you had honor.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Earnest, Devoted)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: And I chose you because you saw the man before the title.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Gravely, Firm)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: She married the man... not the title.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Harsh, Derisive)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: The church married a vagrant to a ruined lady. It never married the Duke of Ashburton to anyone.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Rigid, Formal)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: No Crown license was sought, because no one thought to ask leave for a Duke to marry.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (O.S.) (Sharp)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: No licensed clergyman presided...

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Scathing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: ...because a frightened village priest has no authority to bind a peer.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Thundering)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: And no clerk in London ever entered your name in the Royal register, because as far as the Crown knew, Alexander Ashburton was already dead.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Fierce, Defiant)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I didn't ask this church for permission to survive, Father.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Passionate, Resolute)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I won't ask it for permission to love.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Condescending, Venomous)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: Love doesn't make a Duchess, girl. Paper does.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Accusatory, Pained)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Then look at this floor honestly, for once.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Voice Breaking, Passionate)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: A church called me unworthy.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (O.S.) (Bitter)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: A church chained me.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Furious, Resolute)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Now a church calls my marriage a lie!

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Shouting, Triumphant)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: God married us, Father! You are just angry no one asked you first!

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Resolute)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: A Duke's marriage is judged by the Crown's peerage court, not by a parish priest's seal.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Stern, Unflinching)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: The High Religious Council rules on matters of holy matrimony. That includes yours.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Defiant, Commanding)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: Then let it prove that in ten days, before witnesses. Not with six halberds pointed at me in my own chapel.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Chilling, Victorious)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: Ten days. And if the council rules against you, this county watches you lose her twice.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Steely, Unfazed)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: I'll take that wager over your decree.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Thunderous, Imposing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: Lower them! Or explain to the Crown why its own bailiffs raised iron on the Duke it just confirmed!

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Ominous, Warning)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: Ten days, Duke. Choose your witnesses well.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Booming, Authoritative)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: By Royal command, this sanctuary is placed under immediate Crown scesion.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Stern, Commanding)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: None shall leave until every witness is accounted for.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (O.S.) (Cold, Accusatory)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: You married this woman as a nameless beggar...

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Scornful, Harsh)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: ...in a hedge ceremony no clerk in England ever recorded.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Resonant, Dismissive)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: Three years later, the beggar is revealed to be a Duke. The marriage does not rise with him.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Gravely, Firm)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: She married the man... not the title.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Harsh, Derisive)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: The church married a vagrant to a ruined lady. It never married the Duke of Ashburton to anyone.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Rigid, Formal)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: No Crown license was sought, because no one thought to ask leave for a Duke to marry.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (O.S.) (Sharp)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: No licensed clergyman presided...

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Scathing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: ...because a frightened village priest has no authority to bind a peer.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Thundering)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: And no clerk in London ever entered your name in the Royal register, because as far as the Crown knew, Alexander Ashburton was already dead.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Fierce, Defiant)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I didn't ask this church for permission to survive, Father.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Passionate, Resolute)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I won't ask it for permission to love.

dialogue_segments.text: London closed its doors! My family disowned me!

dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY ASHBOURNE
dialogue_segments.text: She aided the poison in my veins. Cast her into the road.

dialogue_segments.speaker: VAUGHN
dialogue_segments.text: One command, Your Grace, and I drag her past the gates.

dialogue_segments.text: Please, Alexander! Have mercy!

dialogue_segments.text: Stop.

dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: Juliana, she tried to destroy you!

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Calm, Composed)

dialogue_segments.text: She did.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Dignified, Principled)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: But Ashbourne does not throw beggars into the mud.

dialogue_segments.text: If you seek shelter in this house, Catherine, you earn it.

dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: You want me? As a guest?

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Unflinching, Firm)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: As a scullery maid.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Outraged, Venomous)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: You expect me to scrub floors before these commoners?

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Measured, Commanding)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: You will scrub the floors you walked on as an impostor.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Stern, Demanding)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: You will scrub the manor hearths at dawn.

dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE

dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Ten days. He gave himself ten days to fix it.

dialogue_segments.text: Ten days for the council to sit.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Calculating)

dialogue_segments.text: Ten days for a decree to be undone.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Menacing, Resolute)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Ten days is not a wall, Alexander. It's a door.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Chillingly Calm)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: And doors can be closed from the other side.

dialogue_segments.label: AGNES (Hushed, Submissive)
dialogue_segments.speaker: AGNES
dialogue_segments.text: You sent for me, my lady?

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Commanding, Sharp)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Lock it.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Fierce, Hissing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Everyone in that chapel saw me humiliated today.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Spiteful, calculating)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Good. Let them remember it.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Sinister, Predatory)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Grief makes people careless, and carelessness is exactly what I need from that household right now.

dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: And the Dowager?

dialogue_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Dismissive)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Hesitant)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: And Juliana?

dialogue_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Cold, Resolute)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: She goes before the magistrate tomorrow.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Cruel, Exultant)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: She will hang. A perfect solution. The town will cheer as the witch's disgraced daughter faces the noose.

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Resolute, Vengeful)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: I will write the arrest warrant myself.

dialogue_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Chilling, Decisive)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Tomorrow, she stops being a prisoner. She becomes a witch.

logline: The Dowager Duchess realizes Juliana's wedding ring bears the Ashbourne crest belonging to her lost son, but before Juliana can reveal Alexander's name, Rupert and Catherine storm the bedchamber and frame her for poisoning the Duchess.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately from Episode 26's cliffhanger where the Dowager Duchess gripped Juliana's hand upon recognizing the family signet ring, frantically questioning her origin.

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Cold, Authoritative)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Girl. Show me what you are holding.

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Skeptical)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: What is this?

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Steady)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Medicine.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY CATHERINE (Mocking, Condescending)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Medicine? You are a new maid.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY CATHERINE (Incredulous, Accusing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Who permitted you to give medicine to the Duchess?

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Quiet, Resolute)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: No one.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY CATHERINE (Spiteful, Indignant)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Then you administered it without permission.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Passionate, Urgent)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Because she was dying!

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Cold, Interrogating)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: And you decided you knew better than every physician in this house?

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Fierce)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: The physicians were not saving her!

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (O.S.) (Measured, Menacing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: My aunt has been wasting away for months.

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Smooth, Threatening)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: And now we find an unknown maid alone beside her bed...

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (O.S.) (Contemptuous)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: ...holding a substance no one authorized her to give.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Unyielding)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: It is an antidote.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY CATHERINE (Sharp, Provocative)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: An antidote to what?

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (O.S.) (Stern, Barked)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Answer her.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Unyielding, Resolute)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Poison.

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Whispering, Dangerous)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Poison.

logline: Learning from his mother that Rupert and Catherine framed Juliana for witchcraft and sentenced her to death right after their upcoming wedding, Alexander vows to return from the dead and reclaim everything stolen from him.
continuity_notes: Picking up immediately from the revelation in Episode 35 that the men ruling Ashwood orchestrated Alexander's ambush, Alexander learns of Juliana's imprisonment and looming execution.

dialogue_segments.text: When?

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Trembling)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
dialogue_segments.text: After the wedding.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Menacing)

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Grim)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Deadly Serious)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Simmering with Fury)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: They are marrying in two days...

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Deadly, Throaty)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: ...and killing my wife afterward.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Pleading, Terrified)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
dialogue_segments.text: Alexander, you cannot go back there alone!

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Grave, Seething)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: They already took my name.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Roaring with Conviction)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: They stole my home!

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Venomous)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: And now they have taken Juliana!

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Desperate)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: She's still weak, you cannot leave her like this!

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Smooth, Feigning Concern)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: You see?

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Sinister)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN

dialogue_segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Hoarse, Straining)
dialogue_segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
dialogue_segments.text: I am not delusional!

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Condescending, Whispering)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Of course you are not.

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Dismissive)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: You are merely confused.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Amused, Mocking)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: How convenient that the only person who can prove the poison exists...

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Smug)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: ...is the maid who claims to have discovered it.

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Commanding, Resolute)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Take her away before she poisons the rest of this house.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Crying Out)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: No!

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Insolent, Sneering)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Where did a gutter rat like you find a silver locket?

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Screaming, Weeping)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Give it back!

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Anguished)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: It belonged to my mother!

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (O.S.) (Cruel)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: A witch has no need for family heirlooms in the gallows.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Heartbroken)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: My mother's locket!

logline: The High Priest places the sanctuary under Crown seizure and invalidates Alexander and Juliana's wedding for lack of royal license, prompting Alexander to demand a ten-day ecclesiastical trial while Catherine schemes to destroy them.
continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 45's cliffhanger where the High Priest stormed into the church with royal guards and challenged the legality of Alexander and Juliana's marriage.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Harsh, Derisive)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: The church married a vagrant to a ruined lady. It never married the Duke of Ashburton to anyone.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Rigid, Formal)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: No Crown license was sought, because no one thought to ask leave for a Duke to marry.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (O.S.) (Sharp)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: No licensed clergyman presided...

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Scathing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: ...because a frightened village priest has no authority to bind a peer.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Thundering)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: And no clerk in London ever entered your name in the Royal register, because as far as the Crown knew, Alexander Ashburton was already dead.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Fierce, Defiant)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I didn't ask this church for permission to survive, Father.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Passionate, Resolute)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I won't ask it for permission to love.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Condescending, Venomous)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: Love doesn't make a Duchess, girl. Paper does.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Accusatory, Pained)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Then look at this floor honestly, for once.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Voice Breaking, Passionate)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: A church called me unworthy.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (O.S.) (Bitter)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: A church chained me.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Furious, Resolute)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Now a church calls my marriage a lie!

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Shouting, Triumphant)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: God married us, Father! You are just angry no one asked you first!

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Malicious, Taunting)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Careful, healer. The floor isn't finished with you.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (O.S. / Low, Threatening)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: Careful, girl. You mistake my patience for weakness.

logline: The High Priest places the sanctuary under Crown seizure and invalidates Alexander and Juliana's wedding for lack of royal license, prompting Alexander to demand a ten-day ecclesiastical trial while Catherine schemes to destroy them.
continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 45's cliffhanger where the High Priest stormed into the church with royal guards and challenged the legality of Alexander and Juliana's marriage.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (O.S. / Low, Threatening)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: Careful, girl. You mistake my patience for weakness.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Commanding, Severe)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: God did not marry you. A frightened parishioner did, without leave, without license, without the Crown's blessing!

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Booming, Threatening)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: And I have the power to undo in one hearing what took you three years to steal!

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Resolute)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: A Duke's marriage is judged by the Crown's peerage court, not by a parish priest's seal.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Stern, Unflinching)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: The High Religious Council rules on matters of holy matrimony. That includes yours.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Defiant, Commanding)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: Then let it prove that in ten days, before witnesses. Not with six halberds pointed at me in my own chapel.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Chilling, Victorious)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: Ten days. And if the council rules against you, this county watches you lose her twice.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Steely, Unfazed)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: I'll take that wager over your decree.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Thunderous, Imposing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: Lower them! Or explain to the Crown why its own bailiffs raised iron on the Duke it just confirmed!

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Ominous, Warning)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: Ten days, Duke. Choose your witnesses well.

action_segments.label: ACTION

dialogue_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN

dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT

dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: She knows the Duchess was poisoned.

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Fearful)

dialogue_segments.text: And you?

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Pleading, Astonished)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
dialogue_segments.text: How did you escape?

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Somber, Low)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: I crawled away from the battlefield, half dead, alone.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Continuing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: I survived because the men who came looking for me believed I was already dead.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Aghast, Stunned)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
dialogue_segments.text: Then why did they never tell us?

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Ominous, Deliberate)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: Because someone wanted you to believe I was dead.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Breathless)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
dialogue_segments.text: Who?

logline: Inside the opulent Ashbury estate, the treacherous Rupert and Catherine plot to seize the ducal title as the Dowager Duchess slowly withers, while in an icy barn, Juliana defiantly prepares remedies to save the fever-stricken villagers.
continuity_notes: Follows Episode 19's night in the barn; as Alexander begins his clandestine fight to reclaim his birthright, Juliana tends to the suffering village while Rupert and Catherine celebrate their anticipated ascension to the ducal throne.

dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Or has your sudden climb to power sweetened your taste already?

dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Boastful, Confident)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: The estate is practically ours.

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Smug)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: The succession papers are being finalized as we speak.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Cold, Haughty)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: 'Practically' is a word for beggars. I do not marry a practical Duke.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Stern, Ambitious)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: I marry the Lord of Ashbury.

dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: And so you shall.

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Dark, Conspiratorial)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: Once my cousin Alexander's death is formally sealed by the Crown...

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Decisive)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: ...the title is mine.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Wary, Inquiring)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: And what of the Dowager? The old woman still breathes.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Disdainful)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Her shadow still hangs over this house.

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Quiet, Sinister)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: Her health fails more each day. The physicians are baffled.

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Gloating)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: They call it a wasting of the lungs.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Mock-Sympathetic, Cruel)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: How tragic. The slow, quiet decline.

dialogue_segments.label: CLARISSA (Demanding, Brutal)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CLARISSA

dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT

dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE

dialogue_segments.speaker: SEAMUS

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Defiant)

dialogue_segments.label: SEAMUS (Pleading)

dialogue_segments.label: SEAMUS (Frustrated)
dialogue_segments.speaker: SEAMUS

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Passionate, Unflinching)

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Unyielding)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I keep the basket.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Proud, Indomitable)

dialogue_segments.text: They have reduced me to myself.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Steely)

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Cruel, Callous)

dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: She married the man... not the title.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Harsh, Derisive)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: The church married a vagrant to a ruined lady. It never married the Duke of Ashburton to anyone.

dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: No Crown license was sought, because no one thought to ask leave for a Duke to marry.

dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: No licensed clergyman presided...

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Scathing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: ...because a frightened village priest has no authority to bind a peer.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Thundering)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Pleading, Desperate)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Alexander...

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Furious, Cold)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Thunderous, Biting)

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Booming, Condemning)

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Authoritative, Resounding)

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Proclaiming, Powerful)

dialogue_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Weeping, Shaken)

dialogue_segments.text: You let me come here...

logline: After defying her own despair to cure a fever-stricken village boy with her mother's herbal remedies, Lady Juliana learns that the Dowager Duchess is secretly withering away from a mysterious illness inside Ashbury Manor.
continuity_notes: Directly follows Episode 20's cliffhanger where Catherine and Rupert plotted to seize Ashbury upon the Dowager Duchess's demise; in the village, Juliana puts aside her grief over her burned cottage to save young Toby, stumbling upon critical intelligence regarding the manor.

dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: You saved him. The grand doctors left him to choke, but you...

dialogue_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Fervent, Devoted)
dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: I have no money, Lady Juliana, but I swear on my life, I will do anything to repay you.

dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Your brother's breath is payment enough for me, Prudence.

dialogue_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Indignant, Resentful)
dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: At the grand manor, they ignore us. They only care about their own luxury.

dialogue_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Ominous)
dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: But their gold cannot buy them health.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Startled, Curious)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: What do you mean? Is someone ill? The Dowager Duchess?

dialogue_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Solemn, O.S.)
dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: She is dying, Lady Juliana.

dialogue_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Conspiratorial, Grim)
dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: A strange, mysterious illness is eating her away.

dialogue_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Dark, Chilling)
dialogue_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
dialogue_segments.text: Inside that massive house with all their wealth, she is fading to nothing, and no one can stop it.
