dialogue_segments.speaker: POLICE CONSTABLE
dialogue_segments.text: I have more than enough.

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Frantic, Shouting)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Get your hands off me! Catherine!

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate, Screaming)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Do something!

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Shaken, Tearful)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Alexander... I thought you had died.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Choked, Weeping)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Do you know what this did to me?

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (O.S.) (Pleading)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: I mourned you.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Vulnerable, Trembling)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: I waited for you.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Heartbroken)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: For three years, I believed the man I loved was buried somewhere across the sea.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Whispering, Longing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: I never stopped loving you.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Breathless, Hurt)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: You don't remember?

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Desperate, Demanding)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: I was supposed to be your Duchess!

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Implacable)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: You were never my Duchess.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Sobbing, Pleading)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: But I loved you!

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Scornful, Biting)

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Defiant, Pained)

dialogue_segments.text: No!

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Passionate, Crying)

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Fierce, Defiant)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I didn't ask this church for permission to survive, Father.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Passionate, Resolute)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA

dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Voice Breaking, Passionate)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: A church called me unworthy.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (O.S.) (Bitter)

dialogue_segments.text: A church chained me.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Furious, Resolute)

logline: Seeking shelter from the cold rain, Juliana arrives at her new husband's modest woodland cottage and discovers an unexpected sense of peace beside the hearth.

dialogue_segments.text: I am sorry.

dialogue_segments.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Grave, Sincere)
dialogue_segments.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
dialogue_segments.text: You came from comfort.

dialogue_segments.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Grave, Sincere)
dialogue_segments.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Gentle, Peaceful)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: It is quiet.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Gentle, Peaceful)

dialogue_segments.text: Very quiet.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Earnest, Content)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA

dialogue_segments.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Incredulous)
dialogue_segments.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
dialogue_segments.text: You are not disappointed?

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Direct, Soft)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I am.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Warm, Reassuring)

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Determined, Practical)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: If this is our home, I want it clean.

dialogue_segments.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Caring, Tender)

logline: Cornered and chained in the damp dungeon, Juliana shatters Catherine's cruelty with unshakeable dignity and the truth about love and worth, driving Catherine into a murderous fury.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately from Episode 31's cliffhanger where Catherine used a glowing branding iron to scorch Juliana's mother's herbal book.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Grounded, Powerful)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I was freed. And I found a man who never asked me what I was worth.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Tender, Certain)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: My husband.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Bitter)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: He is a nobody.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Warm, Defiant)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Then I love a nobody.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Resonant, Moving)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Because that nobody showed me more love than your entire world ever did.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Indignant, Sharp)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: You know nothing about my world.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Knowing, Sober)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I know exactly what your world values.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Listing, Deliberate)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Beauty. Money.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Firm)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Family. A perfect name.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Continuing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: And a woman who never embarrasses the people standing behind her.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Shouting, Outraged)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: And what is wrong with that?!

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Gentle, Penetrating)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Nothing. Until you have nothing left beneath it.

logline: While secretly administering a charcoal antidote to the poisoned Dowager Duchess in the dead of night, Juliana is stunned when the Duchess suddenly recognizes a distinctive family ring on her hand and fiercely demands the truth about her identity.
continuity_notes: Following her encounter with Alexander in the forest where she vowed to protect the Duchess, Juliana sneaks into the bedchamber at Ashburg Manor to deliver the remaining antidote before Rupert and Catherine's poison takes full hold.

dialogue_segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
dialogue_segments.text: Rupert and Catherine want me dead. They are poisoning me in my own bed, aren't they?

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Reassuring, Steadfast)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Yes. But the charcoal is fighting the poison. You are safe now.

dialogue_segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
dialogue_segments.text: Then tell me... why is a girl of such noble spirit working as a common maid?

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Painful, Proud)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Because my family cast me out to rot. I have nothing left in this world but my honor.

dialogue_segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Breathless, Shaken)

logline: Emerging from the smoke of the shattered cathedral gates in full ducal regalia, Alexander confronts Rupert, wins the loyalty of the royal guards, and is proclaimed the rightful Duke of Ashburn by his weeping mother.
continuity_notes: Directly follows Episode 41 where Alexander's forces breached the cathedral entrance; Alexander now steps through the ruins, halting the wedding and unmasking Rupert's illegitimate reign.

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Furious, Hysterical)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Guards! Arrest this imposter!

dialogue_segments.label: ROYAL GUARD (Stoic, Defiant)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
dialogue_segments.text: We will not.

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Screaming, Outraged)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: I said arrest him!

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate, Unhinged)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Why?!

dialogue_segments.label: ROYAL GUARD (Firm, Reverent)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
dialogue_segments.text: Because we know who he is.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Trembling, Apprehensive)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Rupert...

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Denial, Shaken)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: You cannot be him. Alexander died!

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Commanding)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: And yet, here I stand. That is the lie you built your life upon.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Choked with Tears)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
dialogue_segments.text: Alexander...

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Soft, Reverent)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: Mother.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Overcome, Loving)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
dialogue_segments.text: Look at you... my beautiful boy.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Tearful, Proud)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
dialogue_segments.text: I saw you again... but seeing you like this... I see my son as he was always meant to be.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Tender, Resolute)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: I have come home, Mother.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Ringing, Authoritative)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
dialogue_segments.text: Let everyone hear me! This is my son... Alexander Ashburn. The rightful Duke of Ashburn!

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Commanding, Sharp)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE

dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE

dialogue_segments.text: I chose myself.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Disgusted)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: You chose a beggar.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Fierce, Proud)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I chose a man.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Contemptuous)

dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE

dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
